One day fire broke out in the factory due to electrical fluctuations and resulted in the stock being reduced to ashes. The insurance company agreed to pay the entire claim as demanded by the insured. The company unnecessarily delayed to settle the claim and made the insured run from pillar to post in his bid to get the insurance amount. It never assigned any proper reasons and settled the claim at last when the insured threatened to move the court. The insured went ahead even after receiving his claim and filed a claim against the careless attitude of the insurance company in the consumer court.
